verses.translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

translations.ron: Fost-a iarăşi cuvântul Domnului către mine şi mi-a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ, λέγων,

verses.translation: Son of man, set thy face against Thæman, and look toward Darom, and prophesy against the chief forest of Nageb,

translations.ron: "Fiul omului, întoarce-ţi faţa spre Ierusalim şi vorbeşte împotriva locaşului lor cel sfânt şi prooroceşte împotriva ţării lui Israel.
translations.grk: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου, στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ θαιμὰν, καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ Δαρὸμ, καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπὶ δρυμὸν ἡγούμενον Ναγὲβ,

verses.translation: and thou shalt say to the forest of Nageb, Hear the word of the Lord; thus saith the Lord, even the Lord; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour in thee every green tree, and every dry tree: the flame that is kindled shall not be quenched, and every face shall be scorched with it from the south to the north.

translations.ron: Şi zi pământului lui Israel: Aşa grăieşte Domnul Dumnezeu: Iată, Eu sunt asupra ta şi-Mi voi trage sabia din teaca ei şi voi stârpi din tine pe cel drept şi pe cel necredincios.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐρεῖς τῷ δρυμῷ Ναγὲβ, ἄκουε λόγον Κυρίου· τάδε λέγει Κύριος Κύριος, ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀνάπτω ἐν σοὶ πῦρ, καὶ καταφάγεται ἐν σοὶ πᾶν ξύλον χλωρὸν καὶ πᾶν ξύλον ξηρὸν, οὐ σβεσθήσεται ἡ φλὸξ ἡ ἐξαφθεῖσα, καὶ κατακαυθήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ πᾶν πρόσωπον ἀπὸ ἀπηλιώτου ἕως Βοῤῥᾶ.

verses.translation: And all flesh shall know that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

translations.ron: Şi ca să pierd din tine pe cel drept şi pe cel necredincios, sabia Mea va ieşi din teaca sa spre a lovi tot trupul de la miazăzi până la miazănoapte.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιγνώσεται πᾶσα σὰρξ, ὅτι ἐγὼ Κύριος ἐξέκαυσα αὐτὸ, οὐ σβεσθήσεται.

verses.translation: And I said, Not so, O Lord God! they say to me, Is not this that is spoken a parable?

translations.ron: Atunci va cunoaşte tot trupul că Eu, Domnul, Mi-am scos sabia din teaca ei şi nu se va mai întoarce.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπα, μηδαμῶς Κύριε Κύριε· αὐτοὶ λέγουσι πρὸς μὲ, οὐχὶ παραβολή ἐστι λεγομένη αὕτη;

verses.translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

translations.ron: Tu, fiul omului, suspină atât încât să se frângă şalele tale, suspină cu amărăciune înaintea ochilor lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ, λέγων,

verses.translation: Therefore prophesy, son of man, set thy face steadfastly toward Jerusalem, and look toward their holy places, and thou shalt prophesy against the land of Israel,

translations.ron: Iar când îţi vor zice: "Pentru ce suspini?" Spune-le: Pentru vestea ce vine... şi toată inima se va tulbura, toate mâinile vor slăbi şi toţi genunchii vor tremura ca frunza. Iat-o vine şi este aproape, zice Domnul Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο προφήτευσον υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου, στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγια αὐτῶν,

verses.translation: and thou shalt say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I am against thee, and I will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and I will destroy out of thee the transgressor and unrighteous.

translations.ron: Şi a mai fost cuvântul Domnului către mine şi mi-a zis:
translations.grk: καὶ προφητεύσεις ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ, τάδε λέγει Κύριος, ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς σὲ, καὶ ἐκσπάσω τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξολοθρεύσω ἐκ σοῦ ἄνομον καὶ ἄδικον·

verses.translation: Because I will destroy out of thee the unrighteous and the transgressor, therefore so shall my sword come forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

translations.ron: "Fiul omului, prooroceşte şi zi: Aşa grăieşte Domnul Dumnezeu: "Sabia este ascuţită şi oţelită.
translations.grk: Ἀνθʼ ὧν ἐξολοθρεύσω ἐκ σοῦ ἄδικον καὶ ἄνομον, οὕτως ἐξελεύσεται τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα ἀπὸ ἀπηλιώτου ἔως Βοῤῥᾶ,

verses.translation: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath: it shall not return any more.

translations.ron: E ascuţită ca să junghie mai mult; e oţelită ca să scânteieze ca fulgerul. Ne vom bucura, oare, că sabia fiului meu dispreţuieşte tot lemnul?
translations.grk: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεται πᾶσα σὰρξ, διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος ἐξέσπασα τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ, οὐκ ἀποστρέψει οὐκέτι.

verses.translation: And thou, son of man, groan with the breaking of thy loins; thou shalt even groan heavily in their sight.

translations.ron: Eu am dat-o la oţelit, ca să se ia în mână, şi acum această sabie e ascuţită şi oţelită, gata să fie dată în mâna ucigătorului.
translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου καταστέναξον ἐν συντριβῇ ὀσφύος σου, καὶ ἐν ὀδύναις στενάξεις κατʼ ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if they shall say to thee, Wherefore dost thou groan? that thou shalt say, For the report; because it comes: and every heart shall break, and all hands shall become feeble, and all flesh and every spirit shall faint, and all thighs shall be defiled with moisture: behold, it comes, saith the Lord.

translations.ron: Fiul omului, suspină şi te vaită, că ea e trasă asupra poporului Meu, asupra tuturor căpeteniilor lui Israel; aceştia vor fi daţi sub sabie cu poporul Meu, de aceea loveşte-te cu mâinile peste coapse,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν εἴπωσι πρὸς σὲ, ἕνεκα τίνος σὺ στενάζεις; καὶ ἐρεῖς, ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγγελίᾳ, διότι ἔρχεται, καὶ θραυσθήσεται πᾶσα καρδία, καὶ πᾶσαι χεῖρες παραλυθήσονται, καὶ ἐκψύξει πᾶσα σὰρξ καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα, καὶ πάντες μηροὶ μολυνθήσονται ὑγρασίᾳ· ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται, λέγει Κύριος.

verses.translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

translations.ron: Căci ea e şi încercată acum; şi ce este de mirare dacă ea va nesocoti şi sceptrul? Nici acesta nu va rămâne, zice Domnul Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ, λέγων,

verses.translation: Son of man, prophesy, and thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord; Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and rage,

translations.ron: Dar tu, fiul omului, prooroceşte şi loveşte palmele una de alta şi loviturile sabiei se vor îndoi şi se vor întrei; aceasta este sabia măcelului, sabia cumplitului măcel, sabia care trebuie să-i urmărească,
translations.grk: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον, καὶ ἐρεῖς, τάδε λέγει Κύριος, εἰπὸν, ῥομφαία ῥομφαία ὀξύνου καὶ θυμώθητι,

verses.translation: that thou mayest slay victims; be sharpened that thou mayest be bright, ready for slaughter, slay, set at nought, despise every tree.

translations.ron: Pentru a arunca groază în inimi şi a înmulţi jertfele tot mai mult. Vai! La toate porţile lor voi pune sabie grozavă şi ascuţită spre junghiere, care scânteiază ca fulgerul.
translations.grk: ὅπως σφάξῃς σφάγια, ὀξύνου ὅπως γένῃ εἰς στίλβωσιν, ἑτοίμη εἰς παράλυσιν· σφάζε, ἐξουδένει, ἀπόθου πᾶν ξῦλον.

verses.translation: And he made it ready for his hand to hold: the sword is sharpened, it is ready to put into the hand of the slayer.

translations.ron: Sabie, pregăteşte-te! Ia-o la dreapta şi apucă la stânga, încotro vrei să-ţi întorci faţa ta!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν ἑτοίμην τοῦ κρατεῖν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ· ἐξηκονήθη ἡ ῥομφαία, ἐστὶν ἑτοίμη τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτὴν εἰς χεῖρα, ἀποκεντοῦντος.

verses.translation: Cry out and howl, son of man: for this sword is come upon my people, this sword is come upon all the princes of Israel: they shall be as strangers: judgment with the sword is come upon my people: therefore clap thine hands, for sentence has been passed:

translations.ron: Iar Eu voi bate din palme şi-Mi voi potoli mânia. Eu, Domnul, grăiesc acestea".
translations.grk: Ἀνάκραγε καὶ ὀλύλυξον, υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου, ὅτι αὕτη ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου, αὕτη ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἀφηγουμένοις τοῦ Ἰσραήλ· παροικήσουσιν, ἐπὶ ῥομφαίᾳ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου· διατοῦτο κρότησον ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρά σου,

verses.translation: and what if even the tribe be rejected? it shall not be, saith the Lord God.

translations.ron: Fost-a cuvântul Domnului către mine şi mi-a zis:
translations.grk: ὅτι δεδικαίωται· καὶ τί εἰ καὶ φυλὴ ἀπωσθῇ; οὐκ ἔσται, λέγει Κύριος Κύριος.

verses.translation: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and clap thine hands, and take a second sword: the third sword is the sword of the slain, the great sword of the slain: and thou shalt strike them with amazement, lest the heart should faint

translations.ron: "Tu, fiul omului, închipuieşte-ţi două drumuri pe care trebuie să treacă sabia regelui Babilonului; acestea amândouă trebuie să plece din aceeaşi ţară; apoi închipuieşte-ţi o mână, închipuieşte-o în cetatea Babilonului, de unde pleacă drumurile.
translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον, καὶ κρότησον χεῖρα ἐπὶ χεῖρα, καὶ διπλασίασον ῥομφαίαν· ἡ τρίτη ῥομφαία τραυματιῶν ἐστι, ῥομφαία τραυματιῶν ἡ μεγάλη· καὶ ἐκστήσεις αὐτοὺς,

verses.translation: and the weak ones be multiplied at every gate—they are given up to the slaughter of the sword: it is well fitted for slaughter, it is well fitted for glittering.

translations.ron: Închipuieşte drumul pe care sabia trebuie să vină împotriva cetăţii Raba, a fiilor lui Amon şi împotriva lui Iuda, împotriva Ierusalimului celui întărit,
translations.grk: ὅπως μὴ θραυσθῇ ἡ καρδία, καὶ πληθυνθῶσιν οἱ ἀσθενοῦντες ἐπὶ πᾶσαν πύλην, παραδέδονται εἰς σφάγια ῥομφαίας· εὖ γέγονεν εἰς σφαγὴν, εὖ γέγονεν εἰς στίλβωσιν.

verses.translation: And do thou go on, sharpen thyself on the right and on the left whithersoever thy face may set itself.

translations.ron: Pentru că regele Babilonului s-a oprit la o răspântie, unde încep două drumuri, şi stă să ghicească: scutură săgeţile, întreabă terafimii şi cercetează ficatul.
translations.grk: Καὶ διαπορεύου, ὀξύνου ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων, οὗ ἄν τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐξεγείρηται.

verses.translation: And I also will clap my hands, and let loose my fury: I the Lord have spoken it.

translations.ron: Sorţul din dreapta are scris pe el: "spre Ierusalim", încât el trebuie să îndrepte berbecii, să îndemne la ucidere şi să scoată strigăte de război; să aşeze berbecii împotriva porţilor, să ridice valuri şi să facă turnuri de împresurare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγὼ δὲ κροτήσω χεῖρά μου πρὸς χεῖρά μου, καὶ ἐναφήσω θυμόν μου, ἐγὼ Κύριος λελάληκα.

verses.translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

translations.ron: Acest sorţ s-a părut neadevărat în ochii acelora care au făcut jurăminte mincinoase; dar regele Babilonului, aducându-şi aminte de această necredinţă a lor, a hotărât să ia Ierusalimul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ, λέγων,

verses.translation: And thou, son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may enter in: the two shall go forth of one country; and there shall be a force at the top of the way of the city, thou shalt set it at the top of the way,

translations.ron: De aceea aşa zice Domnul Dumnezeu: De vreme ce voi vă aduceţi aminte de nelegiuirea voastră, făcând ca fărădelegile voastre să fie vădite şi scoţând la iveală păcatele voastre în toate faptele voastre; de vreme ce voi singuri vă aduceţi aminte de acestea, veţi fi prinşi cu mâna.
translations.grk: καὶ σὺ, υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου, διάταξον σεαυτῷ δύο ὁδοὺς, τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν ῥομφαίαν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος, ἐκ χώρας μιᾶς ἐξελεύσονται αἱ δύο, καὶ χεὶρ ἐν ἀρχῇ ὁδοῦ πόλεως, ἐπʼ ἀρχῆς ὁδοῦ διατάξεις,

verses.translation: that the sword may enter in upon Rabbath of the children of Ammon, and upon Judea, and upon Jerusalem in the midst thereof.

translations.ron: Şi ţie, căpetenie nelegiuită şi rea a lui Israel, căreia şi-a venit ziua acum, când nelegiuirea ta a ajuns la culme,
translations.grk: τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν ῥομφαίαν ἐπὶ Ῥαββὰθ υἱῶν Ἀμμὼν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν Ἰουδαίαν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: For the king of Babylon shall stand on the old way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination, to make bright the arrow, and to enquire of the graven images, and to examine the victims.

translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul Dumnezeu: Diadema se va scoate, cununa va fi ridicată, lucrurile se vor schimba; cele smerite se vor înălţa şi cele înalte se vor smeri;
translations.grk: Διότι στήσεται βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐπὶ τὴν ἀρχαίαν ὁδόν, ἐπʼ ἀρχῆς τῶν δύο ὁδῶν, τοῦ μαντεύσασθαι μαντείαν, τοῦ ἀναβράσαι ῥάβδον, καὶ ἐπερωτῆσαι ἐν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς, καὶ κατασκοπήσασθαι.

verses.translation: On his right was the divination against Jerusalem, to cast a mound, to open the mouth in shouting, to lift up the voice with crying, to cast a mound against her gates, to cast up a heap, and to build forts.

translations.ron: O voi lepăda, o voi lepăda, o voi lepăda şi nu va mai fi până va veni acela căruia se cuvine şi o voi da lui.
translations.grk: Ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο τὸ μαντεῖον ἐπὶ Ἱερουσαλὴμ, τοῦ βαλεῖν χάρακα, τοῦ διανοῖξαι στόμα ἐν βοῇ, ὑψῶσαι φωνὴν μετὰ κραυγῆς, τοῦ βαλεῖν χάρακα ἐπὶ τὰς πύλας αὐτῆς, καὶ βαλεῖν χῶμα, καὶ οἰκοδομῆσαι βελοστάσεις.

verses.translation: And he was to them as one using divination before them, and he himself recounting his iniquities, that they might be borne in mind.

translations.ron: Iar tu, fiul omului, prooroceşte şi spune: Aşa grăieşte Domnul Dumnezeu despre fiii lui Amon şi despre ocara lor. Şi le spune: Sabia, sabia este trasă pentru junghiere, este oţelită pentru măcel, ca să scânteieze ca fulgerul.
translations.grk: Καὶ αὐτός αὐτοῖς ὡς μαντευόμενος μαντείαν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν, καὶ αὐτὸς ἀναμιμνήσκων ἀδικίας αὐτοῦ μνησθῆναι.

verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Because ye have caused your iniquities to be remembered, in the discovery of your wickedness, so that your sins should be seen, in all your wickedness and in your evil practices; because ye have caused remembrance of them, in these shall ye be taken.

translations.ron: În mijlocul acelor vedenii deşarte şi prezicerilor tale mincinoase, ea te va face să cazi printre trupurile necredincioşilor, cărora le-a venit ziua atunci când nedreptatea şi-a ajuns culmea.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος, ἀνθʼ ὧν ἀνεμνήσατε τὰς ἀδικίας ὑμῶν, ἐν τῷ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι τὰς ἀσεβείας ὑμῶν, τοῦ ὀραθῆναι ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν, ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἀσεβείαις ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν ὑμῶν, ἀνθʼ ὧν ἀνεμνήσατε, ἐν τούτοις ἁλώσεσθε.

verses.translation: And thou profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day, even an end, is come in a season of iniquity, thus saith the Lord;

translations.ron: O voi întoarce oare în teaca ei? La locul unde ai fost făcut, în ţara unde te-ai născut, te voi judeca;
translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ βέβηλε, ἄνομε, ἀφηγούμενε τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ, οὗ ἥκει ἡ ἡμέρα ἐν καιρῷ ἀδικίας, πέρας,

verses.translation: Thou hast taken off the mitre and put on the crown, it shall not have such another after it: thou hast abased that which was high, and exalted that which was low.

translations.ron: Voi vărsa asupra ta mânia Mea; voi sufla asupra ta focul urgiei Mele şi te voi da în mâna oamenilor barbari, făuritori ai distrugerii.
translations.grk: τάδε λέγει Κύριος, ἀφείλου τὴν κίδαριν, καὶ ἐπέθου τὸν στέφανον, αὐτῇ οὐ τοιαύτη ἔσται· ἐταπείνωσας τὸ ὑψηλὸν, καὶ ὕψωσας τὸ ταπεινόν.

verses.translation: Injustice, injustice, injustice, will I make it: woe to it: such shall it be until he comes to whom it belongs; and I will deliver it to him.

translations.ron: Mâncare focului vei fi; sângele tău va curge în mijlocul ţării şi nici nu se va mai pomeni de tine, că Eu, Domnul, am spus acestea".
translations.grk: Ἀδικίαν, ἀδικίαν, ἀδικίαν θήσομαι αὐτὴν, οὐαὶ αὐτῇ, τοιαύτη ἔσται ἕως οὗ ἔλθῃ ᾧ καθήκει, καὶ παραδώσω αὐτῷ.

verses.translation: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord, concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and thou shalt say, O sword, sword, drawn for slaughter, and drawn for destruction, awake, that thou mayest gleam.

translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον, καὶ ἐρεῖς, τάδε λέγει Κύριος πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀμμὼν καὶ πρὸς τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐρεῖς, ῥομφαία ῥομφαία ἐσπασμένη εἰς σφάγια, καὶ ἐσπασμένη εἰς συντέλειαν, ἐγείρου ὅπως στίλβῃς·

verses.translation: While thou art seeing vain visions, and while thou art prophesying falsehoods, to bring thyself upon the necks of ungodly transgressors, the day is come, even an end, in a season of iniquity.

translations.grk: ἐν τῇ ὁράσει σου τῇ ματαίᾳ, καὶ ἐν τῷ μαντεύεσθαί σε ψευδῆ, τοῦ παραδοῦναί σε ἐπὶ τραχήλους τραυματιῶν ἀνόμων, ἥκει ἡ ἡμέρα ἐν καιρῷ ἀδικίας, πέρας.

verses.translation: Turn, rest not in this place wherein thou wert born: in thine own land will I judge thee.

translations.grk: Ἀπόστρεφε, μὴ καταλύσῃς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ ᾧ γεγέννησαι, ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ ἰδίᾳ σου κρινῶ σε.

verses.translation: And I will pour out my wrath upon thee, I will blow upon thee with the fire of my wrath, and I will deliver thee into the hands of barbarians skilled in working destruction.

translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκχεῶ ἐπὶ σὲ ὀργήν μου, ἐν πυρὶ ὀργῆς μου ἐμφυσήσω ἐπὶ σὲ, καὶ παραδώσω σε εἰς χεῖρας ἀνδρῶν βαρβάρων τεκταινόντων διαφθοράς.

verses.translation: Thou shalt be fuel for fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of thy land; there shall be no remembrance at all of thee: for I the Lord have spoken it.

translations.grk: Ἐν πυρὶ ἔσῃ κατάβρωμα, τὸ αἷμά σου ἔσται ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς σου· οὐ μὴ γένηταί σου μνεία, διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος λελάληκα.
